speaker: Doctor
text: Is the baby feeding well and producing adequate wet diapers, and have you noticed any dark urine or pale, clay-colored stools?

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal urine reducing substances and liver enzymes effectively rule out classic galactosemia and biliary atresia, pointing instead toward a conjugation defect. Given the family history of early liver-related death and the isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, I need to check for the specific enzyme deficiency associated with Crigler-Najjar syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Serum Unconjugated Bilirubin Fraction, Genetic Testing for UGT1A1 Mutation

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal genetic testing results rule out Crigler-Najjar syndrome, which leaves Breast Milk Jaundice as the most likely diagnosis given the exclusive breastfeeding and isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia. I will monitor the bilirubin levels closely to ensure they do not reach toxic levels. DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice
